story.title: Two BASE Jumpers Set Guinness World Records with Red Bull Human Catapult in Slovenia
story.summary: In Trbovlje, Slovenia, two BASE jumpers achieved a remarkable feat by being launched from a 360-meter industrial chimney using what is claimed to be the world's largest human catapult. This event has set two new Guinness World Records.

related_stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Allegations of Affair with Chinese Spy
related_stories.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following reports of his involvement with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be linked to espionage activities. The resignation comes amid growing scrutiny from shareholders and lawmakers regarding his relationships, which have raised national security concerns. CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO.

related_stories.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth Awards Medal to Soldier for Reprimanding Group at Tomb
related_stories.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth awarded Specialist Thomas Iglesias a Joint Service Commendation Medal after Iglesias reprimanded Hegseth and his group for making noise at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. The incident occurred following a Veterans Day ceremony, where the soldier insisted on maintaining silence and respect at the solemn memorial site.

related_stories.title: Jensen Huang Resigns, Leaving Nvidia's Future Uncertain
related_stories.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia, a company he built into a leader in artificial intelligence technology. His departure raises questions about the company's direction and future strategies in the AI sector. Analysts are considering the implications of his exit for Nvidia's ongoing projects and market position.

related_stories.title: Putin Issues Hardline Warnings During US Talks Amid Ukraine's Starlink Disruptions
related_stories.summary: During talks with US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, Russian President Vladimir Putin issued stern warnings regarding foreign military involvement in Ukraine, stating that Russia would target any foreign troops sent to the region. This meeting coincided with reports from Ukraine about renewed disruptions to the Starlink satellite service, which is critical for their military operations.
